item.title: COUNTY OF MAUI PROCLAIMED JUNE AS "WILLIE K MONTH" - Willie K - Hawaiian Musician
item.description: During a press conference held on May 28, 2021, County of Maui Mayor, Michael Victorino, proclaimed the entire month of June 2021 as “Willie K Month”. Ohana Kahaiali’`i and Maui Tribe Productions are planning to celebrate Willie K throughout the month of June on the Official Willie K facebook page.
